resources.string: Always — hovering draws. Pull the pen away from the screen to lift it.
Tap to toggle — tap the screen with the pen to start or stop hover ink.
Hold button — hold the S Pen side button while hovering to draw.
Hover ink off · tap pen to start
Hold the pen button to draw
Smooths out hand shake while hovering. Higher is smoother but trails the pen a little.
Canvas cleared · Undo brings it back

Hold the S Pen just above the screen and move it: Hover Ink draws where the pen points.

Choose how hovering draws with the button on the left of the toolbar:

• Hover: always draws. Pull the pen away to lift it and start a new line.
• Tap: tap the screen with the pen to switch hover ink on or off.
• Button: hold the S Pen side button to draw.

Touching the screen with the pen draws too, with pressure. Fingers are ignored so your palm can rest on the screen (turn on "Fingers can draw" under More).

If nothing happens when hovering, turn on Settings › Advanced features › S Pen › Air view. If the side button opens Air command instead of drawing, use Hover or Tap mode, or turn off opening Air command with the pen button in the S Pen settings.
